# Moore's Law

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
theme_set(ggthemes::theme_fivethirtyeight(base_size = 14))
tableau_colors <- ggthemes_data[["tableau"]][["color-palettes"]][["regular"]][["Tableau 10"]]
tableau <- setNames(tableau_colors$value, tableau_colors$name)
```

## Data Loading

```{r data}
moore <- read_excel("moore.xlsx", sheet = "transistors", 
    col_types = c("text", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "text", "text", "text", "text"))

moore$Yearnum <- moore$Year
moore$Year <- as.Date(paste0(moore$Year, "-01-01"))
moore$t_count <- moore$`Transistor count`
moore$t_log <- log10(moore$`Transistor count`)

View(moore)
```

```{r ggplot}

# Fit linear model
lm_model <- lm(t_log ~ Year, data = moore)

min_x <- min(moore$Year)
max_x <- max(moore$Year)
min_y <- min(moore$t_count, na.rm = TRUE)
max_y <- max(moore$t_count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create prediction data for trend line
pred_data <- data.frame(
  Year = seq(min_x, max_x, by = 30)
)
pred_data$t_log <- predict(lm_model, newdata = pred_data)
pred_data$t_count <- 10^pred_data$t_log
pred_data$date <- as.Date(paste0(pred_data$Year, "-01-01"), format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Calculate growth rate from slope
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]
growth_per_year <- 10^slope  # This gives the multiplication factor per year

cpu_cagr = ((max_y/min_y)^(1/(max(moore$Yearnum)-min(moore$Yearnum)))-1)*100
print(cpu_cagr)

# Create the plot
plot <- ggplot() +
  # Add all model points with lower alpha
  geom_point(data = moore,
             aes(x = Year, y = t_count),
             color = tableau["Blue"],
             alpha = 0.4,
             size = 3) +
  # Add trend line
  geom_line(data = pred_data,
            aes(x = date, y = t_count),
            color = tableau["Blue"],
            size = 1.2) +
  # Add labels using ggrepel for automatic positioning
  # Add trend line annotation
  # Scales
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = 10^seq(floor(log10(min_y)), ceiling(log10(max_y)), by=1),
    labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x)),
    limits = c(floor(min_y), ceiling(max_y))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(as.Date(min_x), as.Date(max_x), by = "5 years"),
    date_labels = "%Y",
    limits = c(as.Date(min_x), as.Date(max_x))
  ) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Transisor counts",
    title = "Transistor counts in CPUs seem to be following Moore's Law and
doubling nearly every 2 years, as forecasted",
    subtitle = paste0("Implied CAGR: 39.53%"),
    caption = "Source: Wikipedia"
  ) +
  scale_colour_tableau() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 6), size = 12, color = "#999999"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10, color = "#666666"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

print(plot)

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  "moore.png",
  plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)


```

## GPUs

## Data Loading

```{r data}
gpu <- read_excel("moore.xlsx", sheet = "GPUs")

gpu$Yearnum <- gpu$Year

gpu$Year <- as.Date(paste0(gpu$Year, "-01-01"))
gpu$t_count <- gpu$`Transistor count`
gpu$t_log <- log10(gpu$`Transistor count`)

gpu$desi <- ifelse(gpu$`Designer(s)` %in% c("Nvidia", "AMD"), gpu$`Designer(s)`, "others")
gpu$manu <- ifelse(gpu$`Fab(s)` %in% c("TSMC"), gpu$`Fab(s)`, "others")
# Create a new column for alpha based on 'desi'
gpu$alpha_value <- ifelse(gpu$desi == "others", 0.7, 0.7) # Lower alpha for "others"
gpu$shape_value <- ifelse(gpu$desi == "others", 21, 21) # Lower size "others"

View(gpu)
```

```{r ggplot}

# Fit linear model
lm_model <- lm(t_log ~ Year, data = gpu)

min_x <- min(gpu$Year)
max_x <- max(gpu$Year)
min_y <- min(gpu$t_count, na.rm = TRUE)
max_y <- max(gpu$t_count, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create prediction data for trend line
pred_data <- data.frame(
  Year = seq(min_x, max_x, by = 30)
)
pred_data$t_log <- predict(lm_model, newdata = pred_data)
pred_data$t_count <- 10^pred_data$t_log
pred_data$date <- as.Date(paste0(pred_data$Year, "-01-01"), format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Calculate growth rate from slope
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]
growth_per_year <- 10^slope  # This gives the multiplication factor per year

growth_rate_percent <- (10^slope - 1) * 100
print(growth_rate_percent*365)  # % growth per year

gpu_cagr = ((max_y/min_y)^(1/(max(gpu$Yearnum)-min(gpu$Yearnum)))-1)*100
print(gpu_cagr)

plot_gpu <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = gpu,
    aes(x = Year, y = t_count, color = desi, fill = desi, shape = desi),
    size = 3,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_data,
    aes(x = date, y = t_count),
    color = tableau["Blue"],
    size = 1.2
  )+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Nvidia" = 21, "AMD" = 21, "others" = 21)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Nvidia" = NA, "AMD" = NA, "others" = NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Nvidia" = "#59A14F", "AMD" = "#F28E2B", "others" = "#BAB0AC")) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = 10^seq(floor(log10(min_y)), ceiling(log10(max_y)), by=1),
    labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x)),
    limits = c(floor(min_y), ceiling(max_y))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(as.Date(min_x), as.Date(max_x), by = "5 years"),
    date_labels = "%Y",
    limits = c(as.Date(min_x), as.Date(max_x))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Transistor counts",
    title = "Transistor counts in GPUs are growing faster than Moore's Law
would predict and the GPU market is dominated by Nvidia and AMD",
    subtitle = paste0("Implied CAGR: 45.44%, exceeding Moore's Law by a small amount"),
    caption = "Source: Wikipedia",
    color = "GPU designer", fill = "GPU designer", shape = "GPU designer"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 6), size = 12, color = "#999999"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10, color = "#666666"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("Nvidia" = "#59A14F", "AMD" = "#F28E2B", "others" = rgb(1,1,1,alpha=0)))


print(plot_gpu)

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  "gpu.png",
  plot_gpu,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
